name: Muse
author: red_thirten@yahoo.com
description:
Muse is a self-hosted Discord music bot that is made for small to medium-sized Discord
servers/guilds.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description:
The token for your Discord bot. Learn how to obtain a token and configure your bot application
properly here: https://jmusicbot.com/getting-a-bot-token/

variables.name: YouTube API Key
variables.description:
Can be acquired by creating a new project in Google's Developer Console
(https://console.developers.google.com/), enabling the YouTube API, and creating an API key under
credentials.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Can be acquired at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard/applications with 'Create a Client ID'.

variables.name: Spotify Client Secret
variables.description: Can be acquired at https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard/applications with 'Create a Client ID'.

variables.name: [Advanced] Release Version Tag
variables.description:
Which release (based on tag) to download from https://github.com/museofficial/muse/releases. To
download the latest release version, "latest" can be used.

variables.name: [System] Force Headless Environment
variables.description:
This should not be changed. It is used by the Egg to tell Ora (a dependency of Muse) that it is
running in a Continuous Integration-like environment (ie. headless), which disables loading spinners
that break the console output.

install.script:
#!/bin/bash

## File: Pelican Muse Egg - egg-muse.json
## Authors: David Wolfe (Red-Thirten), TubaApollo, parkervcp
## Date: 2025/06/25
## License: MIT License

GITHUB_PACKAGE="museofficial/muse"

apt update
apt install -y tar curl jq python3 build-essential

## Muse Install
[ ! -d /mnt/server ] && mkdir /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo -e "
Installing/Updating Muse...
"

# Remove all existing files/folders, except `data` folder
find . -mindepth 1 -depth ! -path './data' ! -path './data/*' -exec rm -rf {} +

# Get download URL
LATEST_JSON=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases/latest")
RELEASES=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases")

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq -r .tarball_url)
else
    VERSION_CHECK=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .tag_name')
    if [ "${VERSION}" == "${VERSION_CHECK}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .tarball_url')
    else
        echo -e "Defaulting to latest release..."
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq -r .tarball_url)
    fi
fi

# Download tarball & check for success
echo -e "Downloading ${VERSION} from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -Lo muse-${VERSION}.tar.gz ${DOWNLOAD_URL}
if [[ ! -f muse-${VERSION}.tar.gz ]]; then
    echo -e "

Failed to download ${VERSION} version of Muse!"
    echo -e "\tTry reinstalling the server again.
"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract & delete tarball
echo -e "Extracting muse-${VERSION}.tar.gz..."
tar -xzvf muse-${VERSION}.tar.gz --strip-components=1
rm muse-${VERSION}.tar.gz

# Install dependencies & clean up
echo -e "Installing dependencies..."
yarn install --prod || exit 1
cp .env.example .env
echo -e "Removing unneeded files..."
rm -rf .dockerignore Dockerfile .gitignore .github/ RELEASING.md

echo -e "
Muse successfully installed!"
